name: combinare
description: Type-safe combinations, Cartesian products and permutations for JavaScript, TypeScript and the command line.

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p config/tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/tests/unit/*.test.js
scripts.test:watch: npm run build && tsc -p config/tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/test-watch.cjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && tsc -p config/tsconfig.test.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=".test-dist/src/**" --test-coverage-lines=90 --test-coverage-functions=90 --test-coverage-branches=90 .test-dist/tests/unit/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:package
